# scripts

CI/CD, research, validation, and Continuous Improvement (CIP) scripts.

## Purpose

- Daily CIP research (`cip-daily-research.mts`).
- CRX aggregation and validation (`crx-aggregate.mts`, `crx-validate.mts`).
- Model spec validation (`validate-model-specs.mts`).
- Provider catalog probes (`probe-cline-kilo.mjs`, `validate-cline-kilo-catalog.mjs`).
- CIP apply (`cip-apply-findings.mts`).

## Ownership

- Maintained by local-router team.
- Scripts operate on data manifests and source-of-truth files under `data/` and `src/model-specs.json`.

## Local Contracts

- Prefer ESM with `.mts`; `.mjs` allowed for Node-only scripts.
- No secrets in script output; redact API keys in research artifacts.

## Work Guidance

- Run scripts from repo root.
- Treat `data/` outputs as input for `src/` routing decisions.

## Verification

- Validate generated CSV/JSON before committing data artifacts.

## Child DOX Index

No child DOX files are required.
